sketches.mechanism: Optional chaining returns nil and silently stops evaluation when any link in the chain is nil
sketches.resonance: Reaching for someone through a chain of connections, but if any link is absent, the whole reaching quietly resolves to nothing.

sketches.mechanism: A goroutine sending on a channel with no receiver blocks forever, and a select with no cases blocks forever
sketches.resonance: A voice that speaks into a channel no one is listening to will wait forever — devotion as deadlock.

sketches.mechanism: A LEFT JOIN preserves every row from the left table even when nothing matches on the right, filling unmatched columns with NULL
sketches.resonance: One side stays complete; the other appears only where it overlaps — the asymmetry of who remains whole after joining.
sketches.draft:
SELECT self.name, other.name
FROM   self
LEFT JOIN other
  ON self.id = other.id
